title: Frohmanian Tether: Conditional Continuation and Small-Data Regularity for 3D Navier–Stokes on T³ (Lean 4 formalization and companion materials)
description:
Strictly conditional, expository companion repository. It does not resolve the Clay Millennium Problem on Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness.

  • Theorem A (Beale–Kato–Majda continuation, one-directional): for each finite T, ∫₀ᵀ‖S(t)‖_{L^∞} dt < ∞ implies the solution continues past T. Conditional on Form B / Hypothesis B.
  • Theorem B (Kato): unconditional local existence and uniqueness for u₀ ∈ Hˢ(T³), s > 5/2.
  • Theorem C (Fujita–Kato): unconditional global regularity for small data, ‖u₀‖_{Ḣ^{1/2}} ≤ εν.
  • Metriplectic geometry: Arnold Lie–Poisson bracket (Jacobi identity cited from Arnold 1966, Marsden–Weinstein 1983, Arnold–Khesin 1998) plus the symmetric, degenerate tether B(F,H) ≡ 0.
  • Clay Statement (B), global regularity for arbitrary large data: OPEN.

The Lean 4 file FrohmanianTripleArchitecture.lean (Lean 4.30.0-rc1, Mathlib v4.30.0-rc1) is a machine-checked proof of the metriplectic algebra, tether degeneracy and symmetry, the ℝ³ alignment-kernel bound, and Grönwall logic over abstract PDE input types. It has zero sorry and uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The Navier–Stokes analytic content (BKM, the vorticity growth inequality, Lie–Poisson skew-symmetry) enters as assumed structure fields and is not derived in Lean.
